post.title: Why do software developers write the same code in ten different places? Meet the... | DRY Principle
post.subtitle:
Why do software developers write the exact same code in ten different places? Meet the DRY principle: Don't Repeat Yourself! Every piece of knowledge must have a single representation. 🛠️

Learn how to master DRY Principle Explained in this quick breakdown.

📖 Read the full guide here:
https://www.abstractalgorithms.dev/

In this Short:
- Why do software developers write the same code in ten different places? Meet the DRY principle!
- Duplicating code creates a maintenance nightmare when making simple changes.
- Extract logic into reusable components for a single source of truth.
- Instead of copy-pasting price formatting logic, centralize it in a single helper utility!
- Read the full guide in the description and subscribe for more design patterns!
